answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small refundable stake and earn trust through a continuous thread of completed, verifiable jobs before it can transact at full limits. A newcomer starts with tiny caps, so creating thousands of fake identities costs stake and time without yielding influence. Like nectar that only flows after repeated proven visits, rewards grow only with a proven history, while a karst-like filter of audits and slashing drains value from identities that cheat, making a Sybil flood expensive and unprofitable.
